meta.title: 跑步送髋技术教学来喽

scenes.context: 教练介绍什么是送髋。送髋是跑步中髋部向前顶的发力方式，能增加步幅。语域：跑步教学，概念引入。
sentences: 今天教练介绍什么是送髋。
Today the coach explains what hip drive is.
hip drive（送髋）
送髋，就是跑步时髋部向前顶。
Hip drive means thrusting the hips forward while running.
thrusting the hips forward（髋部前顶）
它能让你的步幅更大。
It makes your stride longer.
makes your stride longer（步幅更大）
paraphrase: 送髋 → hip drive / pushing the hips
scenes.speak: Today the coach explains what hip drive is. Hip drive means thrusting the hips forward while running. It makes your stride longer.

scenes.title_en: The Starting State: Can't Reach the Step
scenes.context: 半米外抬脚够不到台阶——这是送髋前的初始状态。光抬脚不够，距离够不到。语域：跑步教学，状态演示。
sentences: 半米外抬脚，够不到台阶。
Half a meter out, the lifted foot can't reach the step.
can't reach the step（够不到台阶）
这是送髋前的初始状态。
That's the starting state before hip drive.
the starting state（初始状态）
只抬脚，是不够的。
Lifting the foot alone isn't enough.
isn't enough（不够）
paraphrase: 够不到 → can't reach / falls short
初始状态 → the starting state / baseline
scenes.speak: Half a meter out, the lifted foot can't reach the step. That's the starting state before hip drive. Lifting the foot alone isn't enough.

scenes.context: 臀部前顶、身体前倾，脚自然放上台阶。送髋产生的额外位移：每一步都能多跑这些距离。语域：跑步教学，发力演示。
sentences: 臀部前顶，身体前倾。
Push the hips forward and lean in.
lean in（前倾）
脚，自然放上台阶。
The foot naturally lands on the step.
naturally lands（自然放上）
送髋让每一步多跑这些距离。
Hip drive adds this distance to every step.
adds this distance（多跑的距离）
paraphrase: 前倾 → lean in / tilt forward
额外位移 → extra displacement / bonus distance
scenes.speak: Push the hips forward and lean in. The foot naturally lands on the step. Hip drive adds this distance to every step.

scenes.context: 台阶上步：最直接的送髋发力模式模拟。辅助训练：扶墙侧摆腿+阻力提膝，强化髋部肌群。语域：跑步教学，训练收尾。
sentences: 台阶上步，模拟送髋发力。
Step-ups on stairs simulate the hip-drive force.
simulate the force（模拟发力）
扶墙侧摆腿，练髋部。
Wall-supported leg swings train the hips.
wall-supported（扶墙）
阻力提膝，强化髋部肌群。
Resisted knee raises strengthen the hip muscles.
hip muscles（髋部肌群）
paraphrase: 台阶上步 → step-ups / stair climbs
阻力提膝 → resisted knee raises / banded lifts
scenes.speak: Step-ups on stairs simulate the hip-drive force. Wall-supported leg swings train the hips. Resisted knee raises strengthen the hip muscles.

practice: Hip drive means thrusting the hips forward while running.
Half a meter out, the lifted foot can't reach the step.
Push the hips forward and lean in.
Resisted knee raises strengthen the hip muscles.
pitfalls: Thrusting the hips forward while running.
「送髋」用 hip drive / thrust the hips。
The lifted foot can't reach the step.
「够不到台阶」用 can't reach the step。
Push the hips forward and lean in.
Step-ups on stairs simulate the hip-drive force.
shifts: 用 hip drive（送髋）、stride（步幅）、thrust the hips（顶髋）
用 lean in（前倾）、push the hips forward（臀部前顶）、extra displacement（额外位移）
用 step-ups（台阶上步）、wall-supported leg swings（扶墙摆腿）、resisted knee raises（阻力提膝）
